nom: CeraVe Balancing Air Foam Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and mattifies the T-zone without over-drying, and some pair it with a heavier moisturizer to offset residual dryness.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry to oily skin hoped it would work for her sensitive skin, but dedicated dry-skin feedback is otherwise limited.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers repeatedly say it balances oil on the T-zone while keeping the rest of the face soft and hydrated, with several calling it a new staple for skin that is normally hard to please.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation, no redness and no breakouts, though one found it still left her skin dry afterward and another had a mild breakout despite being described as acne-prone rather than sensitive.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal to combination skin say it cleans thoroughly while leaving skin balanced, not tight.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically discuss mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer explicitly links this product to fine lines, wrinkles or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not strip or tighten skin and leaves it soft and hydrated; a minority (including one 3-star review) report noticeable dryness or tightness after cleansing.
concerns.redness: The few reviewers who mention redness say it calmed or did not trigger irritation, with no reports of redness worsening.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the ceramides with keeping the moisture barrier intact, describing skin as clean but not stripped; no reviewer reports barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for acne-prone skin mostly report clearer skin and reduced breakouts over weeks of use; one reviewer with acne-prone skin reports a mild breakout and another notes cystic-type flare-ups are not mentioned but a mild breakout did occur.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers say it helped clear existing breakouts or pores over time, though one acne-prone reviewer experienced a mild breakout after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers consistently report reduced shine and a more matte T-zone without feeling over-dried.

aspects.libelle: Feels too light for full makeup removal

extraits.texte: The reason I gave it 3 stars is because even though it's very soft and gentle on the skin I felt as if it left my skins very dry after then cleanse. The liquid was actually very foamy when being pumped out the bottle and the amount that you need is very little. I did love that about the product. Also didn't have a scent but your face did feel very clean after the use. A big plus that's it's very sensitive to the skin didn't break me out nor did it cause any irritation. Definitely worth it to try my only issue with this product was the after dryness on my face but if you have sensitive skin then I would definitely recommend it.

extraits.titre: Not the best, not the worst
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product wasn't my favorite, however it wasn't terrible either. I enjoyed the foamy texture and the slight glow of my skin after using it, as well as the convenient pump to dispense from, however I have acne-prone skin, and this made me have a mild breakout. The scent isn't good or bad, but how closely it smells to bar soap is unappealing. My skin didn't really feel clean after using it, even though it looked clean. All of those factors together make me wonder if it leaves residue of some sort, even if rinsed well. I'd recommend this to someone with non-sensitive, non-acne-prone skin for a simple, gentle clean.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Okay, I'm actually obsessed with this cleanser. I have normal to combination skin and this stuff gets it. The foam is super light and airy (like a cloud on your face), but it still makes my skin feel clean, fresh, and not stripped. It says it helps control oil, and honestly? It does. My T-zone doesn't get nearly as shiny during the day, but the rest of my face still feels soft and hydrated. Plus, the formula has ceramides and allantoin, which my skin loves. No tightness or weird reactions—just happy, balanced skin. Bonus points for the pump being mess-free and giving the perfect amount every time. 🙌 Highly recommend if you're looking for a daily cleanser that won't mess with your skin barrier but still makes your face feel super clean.

extraits.titre: My sensitive skin loved this cleanser
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone who has extremely sensitive skin to the point we're most face cleaners either dry me out or break me out. I tired this and was shocked at how it cleaned my face without leaving it dry and no break outs in sight. I love how gentle it was on my skin but really got down into my pipes to leave my skin feeling super fresh and clean. I will be repurchasing this for myself and my sister who struggles with the same sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foaming facial cleanser by CeraVe worked great for my combination and acne-prone skin. It claims to have hydrating and oil-controlling technology, which initially I was skeptical of as I have a very difficult time finding a good cleanser for my skin. However, after weeks of using this product, I am a believer! It left my t-zone more matte, but did not make the rest of my face dry. This will be a re-purchase!

The CeraVe Balancing Air Foam Foaming Facial Cleanser has been a game changer for my sensitive skin. It feels super gentle, calms down irritation, and has really helped clear up my acne without drying me out. I love how light and soothing the foam is-definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!

I received the CeraVe Balancing Air Foam Cleanser for free in exchange for my honest review. I think it's an okay cleanser, but it feels so lightweight that it doesn't clean my skin as thoroughly as I'd like—especially when I'm wearing makeup. On the positive side, it doesn't irritate or dry out my skin, which is great for sensitive days, and the packaging is convenient and easy to use. I usually love other CeraVe cleansers, but this one just isn't my favorite.
